title: Italian Tomato Toast with Soft Egg
summary: Crisp toasted bread topped with garlicky crushed tomatoes, basil and a soft-cooked egg. It’s a simple vegetarian Italian-style breakfast that feels fresh, savoury and satisfying.
steps: Bring a small saucepan of water to a gentle boil. Lower in the eggs and cook for 6 minutes for soft, jammy yolks, then transfer to cold water for 1 minute and peel carefully.

Meanwhile, grate the tomatoes on the coarse side of a box grater into a bowl, discarding the skins. Crush or finely grate half the garlic clove into the tomatoes, then stir in the olive oil, salt, black pepper and torn basil.
Toast the wholemeal bread until deeply golden and crisp at the edges. Rub the hot toast lightly with the remaining garlic clove.
Spoon the crushed tomato mixture generously over the toast. Halve the soft eggs and place one on each serving, seasoning with a little extra black pepper if liked.
Serve immediately while the toast is still crisp and the eggs are warm.
